new_defects.evidence: charter/DONE/mg-pii-name-1.md prescribes 'Replace each with "the owner"'. project/planning/EVAL-STANDARDIZATION-PLAN.md:21 does that correctly ('Authority: the owner requested...'), but EVAL-STANDARDIZATION-PLAN.md:24 and project/planning/ROADMAP.md:34 read '...assigns implementation after / The owner confirms staffing.' and '...features after / The owner confirms staffing.' — each continues a sentence that begins on the previous wrapped line, so the article is capitalised mid-sentence (it inherited the capital of the replaced proper noun). Meaning, scope and readers' interpretation are unchanged; no proof in the DONE list is affected and no PII remains. Typographic only, recorded rather than fixed because the checkout is frozen and read-only. Evidence: ~/.local/share/agent-private/mister-clean/master-gate/pii1/qa/evidence-diff.txt.
